title: Andrew Hilger, former president of Allegis Group — 'Eric Ries shows us that this is not an inevitable, inexorable march'
summary: Hilger read the book against the pattern he has watched run: the founder leaves or the company goes public, the decision horizon shortens, and the mission stays on the wall but not in the decisions. He also reports that Eric spoke to Tony O'Driscoll's Business as a Force for Good class at Duke.
blockquote: Eric Ries shows us that this is not an inevitable, inexorable march. Founders can make different choices. In fact, many have (see Vanguard, Costco Wholesale, Patagonia, Novo Nordisk, Devoted Health). In Incorruptible, he lays out the blueprint for those choices.
attribution_title: Former President, Allegis Group · TEDx speaker
